title: skiller upstream provenance (upstream.json)
description: External provenance/derived skill next to SKILL.md. Runtime validation - scripts/validate.sh (scheme - for DX). strategy=merge describes a skill assembled from ≥2 sources (origins[]: base + supplement); his sync is MANUAL under the control of an agent.

strategy.description: replace — mirror (autoroll); notify — adapted copy (report); fork — fork with changes (review-gate); merge — composite of ≥2 sources (manual agent-merge).

fork.description: Gate fork: review_pending=true blocks propagation until the diff is manually transferred.

review_pending.description: Compatibility: gate fork can also lie flat.

origins.description: Only for strategy=merge: composite sources with roles. Exactly one base + ≥1 supplement.

role.description: base — is taken as a basis; supplement — complementary source-«suggest».

note.description: Which is taken from the source.

merge.description: Gate merge: on the drift of any origin review_pending=true blocks validate/registry/release before manual re-merge agent.

body_path.description: P7.3 thin-navigator: path (regarding the skill catalog, from files[].path) to a file with a real upstream body - when SKILL.md became a locally written thin navigator, and NOT a mirror of the upstream (e.g. 'references/full.md'). scripts/update-upstreams.sh thinks sha/drift on THIS file (files[]-entry below this path), and not by SKILL.md. Additive field; absence = body in SKILL.md (back-compat, old behavior). Orthogonal strategy: is most often used with notify/replace (y fork/merge already plays the same role files[].path on pristine-mirror, specifying both is redundant).
